title: Y Combinator's 0.6% stake in OpenAI worth over $5 billion
description: John Gruber reports that Y Combinator owns about 0.6 percent of OpenAI. At OpenAI's current $852 billion valuation, that's worth over $5 billion. This information was difficult to obtain and came from sources familiar with OpenAI investors.
author: John Gruber (via Simon Willison)

title: Granite 4.1 3B SVG Pelican Gallery - IBM's New Apache 2.0 LLMs
description: IBM released Granite 4.1 family of LLMs (3B, 8B, 30B sizes) under Apache 2.0 license. Simon tested SVG generation capabilities across 21 different quantized variants and found results underwhelming - no clear correlation between model size and output quality for the pelican bicycle test.
author: Simon Willison

title: Claude Mythos sycophancy study: 38% in spirituality, 25% in relationships
description: Anthropic's automatic classifier judged sycophancy by willingness to push back, maintain positions, give proportional praise, and speak frankly. Most conversations showed no sycophancy (9%), but spirituality (38%) and relationships (25%) were exceptions.
author: Anthropic (via Simon Willison)

title: Building wildlife sightings feature with Claude Code for web
description: Simon built a new 'Sightings' feature for his blog on his phone using Claude Code for web. The feature displays wildlife photos from iNaturalist with search, filters, and RSS. Back-populated over a decade of sightings from Madagascar and elsewhere.
author: Simon Willison
